name: Neumann Gradient
definition: Gradient estimation taking 26 neighboring voxels as input. Based on linear regression, it produces nearly isotropic gradients with less fringing artifacts. It also allows filtering original voxel values with low additional cost.
summary: The Neumann Gradient is a high-quality 3D gradient estimation method for scalar volumes that uses linear regression on a 3x3x3 neighborhood to produce nearly isotropic vectors with reduced fringing artifacts.
